title: Present Suffering and Future Glory
definition: Present Suffering and Future Glory refers to the biblical hope of God’s final purposes in Christ.
summary: Present Suffering and Future Glory refers to the biblical hope of God’s final purposes in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the center and guarantee of God’s promised future.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Present Suffering and Future Glory places present life under the future God has promised. God reveals the future to produce holiness, endurance, comfort, and gospel urgency.

Scripture teaches the last things to produce hope, holiness, endurance, and urgency rather than speculation. People need hope that is stronger than suffering and clearer than speculation.

Christ stands at the center of this future. Jesus is the center and guarantee of God’s promised future. Because of Him, believers can face death, judgment, suffering, and the future with sober confidence rather than fear.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
The coming future exposes what truly matters now. People need hope that is stronger than suffering and clearer than speculation. Scripture’s teaching about the last things steadies the heart in a world that feels unfinished.

It also guards the Church from fear-based prophecy and careless delay. The Lord calls His people to watchfulness, holiness, comfort, mission, and trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live today in light of Christ’s coming kingdom. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
